title: The Tech Truce Starts To Fray

The Tech Truce Starts To Fray

Arthur Kroeber, Laila Khawaja, AJ Cortese, Tom Hancock

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 10 Aug 2026

In May, presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping promised a new era of “constructive strategic stability.” What we have seen since then is a simmering tension, as the US has tried to restrict Chinese tech imports through a series of measures by a new actor, the Federal Communications Commission. China finally responded in early August with a calibrated set of its own restrictions, designed to respond to the US but not to escalate. These maneuvers show that the US-China relationship is actually an uneasy stalemate, in which both sides continue to seek ways to unwind their tech dependencies.
